title: Pumping Irony
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Show Gertie how to use the nearby Heavy Bag then go to MutantMania's Level 4 and teach Abraham the Animal a lesson. Afterward, meet with Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Show Gertie how to use the nearby Heavy Bag then go to MutantMania's Level 4 and teach Abraham the Animal a lesson. Afterward, meet with Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

My word! You have such big...muscles! *Giggle!* I hope to have muscles as big as yours some day.

Thanks for coming to help me with my workout. Colonel Cabo says I need to get more work on the heavy bag. Can you show me how to do it correctly? You can use the heavy bag near the back of this gym.

When you're done, could you help me with something else? *Bats eyelashes* There is a ruffian on level 4 named Abraham the Animal who keeps picking on me because I'm a girl. Could you maybe spar with him until he agrees to leave me alone? I'd appreciate your help ever so much!

Turn-in:

Welcome back, friend. Ah hope you taught Gertie some good lessons. She's a good kid and Ah plan on riding her to the top. Ah mean using her. Ah mean being her manager.

Objectives:

  • ''Spar'' with Abraham the Animal

Level range: 82–100
